objective: OLD-CORE-20261112-001 direction 1 (G17 with G7), at the coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-12: the dying core of growth with closings anywhere ends, but patterns with its degrees do not. Which structure beyond degrees carries the end? A ladder of resamples of each dying core, each fair by construction and checked on enumerated small cases: degrees only (a switch chain), degrees with each knot's youngest distinction kept (so every count of knots among the oldest j distinctions is kept), the youngest kept with the other two redrawn among older ones, and the whole core redrawn under the growth's own rule. Keeping the pair counts reproduces the end by the pair-count lemma, so it is a check, not a test. Standalone value relative to the nearest known work: degree-preserving switch chains and grown-network effects are known; what ends grown not-all-equal patterns was not found.
